project.title: Northstar Commerce
project.definition: A commerce workspace that keeps purchase completion and sellable inventory consistent.

domains.title: Purchase
domains.definition: The responsibility boundary for turning a reviewed cart into a confirmed order.

domains.title: Inventory
domains.definition: The responsibility boundary for maintaining trustworthy sellable stock.

capabilities.title: Checkout
capabilities.definition: Authorize a purchase and produce an order confirmation.

capabilities.title: Inventory Sync
capabilities.definition: Reconcile storefront availability with warehouse stock.

competencyAnswers.scope: Independent merchants completing orders without overselling.
competencyAnswers.domains: Purchase owns order confirmation; Inventory owns sellable stock.
competencyAnswers.abilities: Checkout completes purchases and Inventory Sync reconciles availability.
competencyAnswers.evidence: README product prose and the two feature directories jointly support the abilities.
competencyAnswers.impact: Checkout depends on trustworthy inventory availability before confirmation.
